notes:
Inbound from self-serve signup (product tour -> API key). Early-stage SMB building an in-app chat assistant for their B2B support product. Primary ask: sub-200ms perceived latency for streaming replies, reliable token streaming (SSE/websocket), and predictable per-token unit costs. Very pragmatic — wants hosted API first, may move to Dedicated later if traffic justifies it.

Customer quotes: "Users abandon the assistant if the first tokens take >150ms — streaming start time is make-or-break."

Technical constraints / preferences: prefer public cloud (US-west region), plan to use small open models for cost (7B-13B quantized), but want Redwood's verified perf profiles. Need prefix/KV caching for chat sessions and per-user session affinity. Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to cheaper 7B variant when heavy load, but strict p95 SLOs for premium customers.

Security/compliance: SOC2-in-progress. Requires SSO/SAML, audit logs and data retention controls. DPA under legal review — blocker for enterprise payment but not for POC.

Commercial: price-sensitive. Interested in usage-based hosted pricing and a short POC. Accepts small monthly commit if latency + streaming is validated.

Suggested approach: provide a POC playbook (traffic generator + sample prompts), short perf-run script, and a simple sample app with streaming websocket to demonstrate UX latency. SE to propose config: streaming_enabled=true, batching conservative, kv_cache=true, model=redwood-curated-7b-q4 as starting point.
